highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: WhatsApp patches three security flaws including one exploited in scam campaign and CISA adds four critical vulnerabilities to its known exploited catalog. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Badbox malware botnet returns with record-breaking ad fraud. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Researchers uncover widespread data leakage in AI service networks. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
